messages:
Alex: Heads-up: quick webinar next Tue 9am PT (APAC-friendly). Topic: inference benchmark - latency vs cost. Need reg page, Zoom cloud recording + transcript, captions, and HubSpot lead routing. Can we ship by Thu EOD?
Priya: Yep. Reuse 'Webinar Lite' template? Less dev overhead.
Jamie: I can update the template. Copy ideas?
Sam: Need UTMs + GA event and thank-you flow with replay + 1-question NPS. Propose utm_source=organic&utm_campaign=bench_q2.
Luis: Sales asks: include checkbox "Interested in Dedicated demo", capture company_size and role. Want CSV export 24-48h after event.
Priya: Zoom plan: co-hosts Alex & Priya, auto-record cloud, mute on entry, live transcript on, waiting room off to reduce friction.
Alex: Waiting room off ok. Save raw recording to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/bench-q2/.
zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/912345678 (passcode sent). Cloud recording enabled. Transcript enabled.
Jamie: Draft reg page copy:
- Hero: "Predictable inference: ship faster, spend less"
- Bullet A: Live benchmark comparing latency vs cost
- Bullet B: Practical tuning + routing playbook
CTA: "Reserve your spot"
Priya: Post-event flow: raw -> auto-transcribe (24h) -> clip pipeline -> 48h nurture email with highlights -> 5-day sales CSV. I'll own uploading raw + captions.
Sam: HubSpot mapping: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, company_size, interested_in_dedicated (checkbox), utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_content. Embed snippet below:
```
<form id=\"hs_form\">
  <input name=\"email\">
  <input name=\"first_name\">
  <input name=\"last_name\">
  <input name=\"company\">
  <input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"interested_in_dedicated\">
</form>
```
Alex: We'll A/B test messaging on reg page: variant A=cost-first, variant B=speed-first. Tag utm_content=cost or utm_content=speed.
Luis: Follow-up rules: prioritize leads who checked dedicated or company_size>500. Set HubSpot owner to @Luis for qualified leads, send CSV to my inbox.
Priya: Checklist & timeline: reg page live Thu 5pm, Zoom test Wed 11am, slides due Mon EOD, retention 90 days, captions + SRT attached. I'll open preflight thread tomorrow.
Sam: I'll configure UTMs, GA event, and shortlink (bit.ly/redwood-bench).
Jamie: Need legal sign-off for benchmark comparisons - pinged @Legal.
Alex: Any blockers?
Priya: All good, marking on-track :thumbsup:
